description: Honest coverage when part of a search fails. Three probes go out for this query — the whole phrase and each term — and the fixture makes the 'corroboration' probe fail the way a broken workspace does. The two that answered are returned, the outcome is partial rather than success, and failed_probes says how much recall was lost. Reporting success here would present a thin answer as a complete one.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
